jess: heads up — saw a weird one during demos. toggled org from A -> B and the right-hand inspector panel still showed A's quota/metrics for ~3s. :eyes:
kevin: ugh. can you repro reliably? steps?
jess: yes — quick steps: 1) open dashboard as org A, 2) open card inspector on a user row, 3) switch org via top-left org toggle to org B, 4) click same user row quickly. inspector shows A's values for a moment then refreshes. repro on prod and staging-2.
mira: can you paste any browser console or network trace? headers?
jess: grabbing HAR now. noticed prefetch call to /internal/cards/prefetch with header `x-workspace-id: A` and then a follow-up request after toggle still returned the cached card payload; UI merged it while the new fetch completed.
sophie: so UI is optimistic-merging prefetch results into panel before confirming workspace header? seems like our client cache key is just `cardId` not `cardId|workspace`.
mira: confirmed in edge logs: 2026-03-15T14:22:10Z edge-proxy prefetch id=abc123 x-workspace-id=A cache-hit=true -> served. later at 14:22:11Z switch event triggered, client did fetch x-workspace-id=B but UI used cached payload while backend returned 200. i can share query: `request.path:/internal/cards/prefetch AND response.cache_status: HIT AND request.headers.x-workspace-id:A`
kevin: sounds like a cache key mismatch across client+edge. Also possible routing policy: the prefetch route sets affinity-tag=workspace but the cookie wasn't rotated on toggle.
sophie: quick mitigation: client should tag cache entries with workspace id and ignore stale entries on org toggle. server-side: make prefetch respect `cache-key: workspaceId` or add `Vary: X-Workspace-Id`.
jess: agreed. small patch proposal: UI change that flushes card-cache on org toggle + add a guard `if (cached.workspace !== currentWorkspace) skipApply()` and server side add `Vary` header for prefetch responses.
mira: I'll instrument a telemetry metric: `console.card.binding_mismatch` with labels {from_workspace,to_workspace,env} and ship it behind flag. will add a log alert if rate > 0.1% of card loads.
kevin: rollout plan: patch UI + unit tests -> canary 5% on staging -> deploy edge change with 10% traffic canary, keep telemetry on for 48h -> full rollout. need SRE signoff for cache invalidation risk.
sophie: small PR snippet for UI check: ```js
const cached = cache.get(cardId);
if (cached && cached.workspaceId !== currentWorkspaceId) {
  // don't apply stale card
  return fetchFresh();
}
```
deploy-bot: deploy queued: `edge-proxy-canary` -> 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC (auto) :rocket:
mira: also want to add a quick Grafana panel: `sum(rate(console.card.binding_mismatch[5m])) by (from_workspace,to_workspace)` so we can spot noisy tenants. added a note to runbook to check canary scoreboard.
jess: thanks team — I'll open the UI PR and link the HAR + screenshots. marking this P1 for demo-day CVE (visual leakage) until mitigated. :+1:
